changelog:
STILL ON VERSION 1.6.6? If Install says "App not installed", do this once (we changed the app's security key):
1. Make sure you have the Downloader app (Main Apps, Amazon Appstore or Google Play).
2. Uninstall Snow Media Center: Main Apps > Snow Media Center > Uninstall, or Settings > Applications > Snow Media Center > Uninstall.
3. Open Downloader, enter code 9073972 and install.
4. Open Snow Media Center and sign in once. Updates install normally again after this.

WHAT'S NEW
Profiles for the whole house: everyone gets their own profile with its own Continue Watching, My List, Live TV favourites and home screen, and it follows your Snow Media account to any box. Add a 4-digit PIN to any profile; forgot it? After a few tries, Forgot PIN emails you a reset code. Set them up under Settings > Profiles or with the profile button at the top of Home.
Kids profiles: pick Little kids (G and TV-Y), Kids (up to PG and TV-PG) or Teens (up to PG-13 and TV-14). Plex, Live TV and the Snow AI all stay within that age, with no Store, Main Apps, requests or Settings, and grown-up profiles stay behind their PIN.
Game Lounge: Blackjack, Casino Hold'em, Roulette, Slots, Plinko, Dice, Snow Trivia and more, played with your remote. Free chips from the Daily Spin, lounge music you can turn up, down or skip, and a Kids Game Lounge with games made for them. All just for fun, no real money.
Plex, faster and smarter: when a movie comes in 4K and 1080p, pick the one you want before it plays. If your internet slows down, the Player drops the quality to keep playing and raises it again when your speed comes back. A few seconds of loading ahead when you press Play means far less buffering.
Plex Continue Watching is back and fixed: it saves where you stopped even while a stream is still starting, and your TV libraries now show the next episode of a show you finished an episode of.
Plex Home and Discover: new rows for What others are watching, each streaming service (Netflix, Hulu, Peacock and more), decades and genres, with the highlighted title's artwork filling the screen behind the rows. Moving up and down always shows the whole row, title included.
Request movies and shows inside Plex: search for anything; if it isn't on Plex yet, a "Request it" row shows it, and OK requests it (shows with every season). This box gets a notification when it's ready, even with the app closed. A title that's on Plex under a different name now shows up in search too.
Phone remote: Settings > Phone Remote shows a QR code and a code; scan it or go to snowmediaent.com/remote, then move, select, go back, play/pause, type into any search or sign-in box, and talk to it, all from your phone. The "Type on your phone" card shows the first three times you type on the TV, with "Don't show again"; turn it back on any time in Settings > Phone Remote.
Voice commands: press the mic on the home screen (or the Search button on your remote) and just say it: "put on ESPN", "watch The Office", "open YouTube", "take me to the Guide", "search for Batman". Anything else goes to the Snow Media AI, which answers or takes you there. Kids profiles keep their limits.
Game Day: a section in the Player (next to Guide) with today's games across every pro sport: NFL, college football, NBA, WNBA, college basketball, MLB, NHL, UFL, MLS, NWSL, Premier League, La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga, Ligue 1, Liga MX, Champions and Europa League, UFC, plus F1, NASCAR and IndyCar races, PGA and LPGA golf and the big tennis tournaments. Live scores first, every channel carrying each game (event channels like MLB 07 found by name, locals and networks by the Guide), a Pay-Per-View list for fights and events, Watch to put it on, and Remind me for a popup at kickoff. Back from a game returns to its channels, then to Game Day.
Snow AI for kids is safeguarded: on a Kids profile the AI is G-rated and only helps with kids shows, movies, channels and games.
Snow AI Free or Premium: Settings > UI > Snow AI switches AI Chat and voice commands between the included AI and Premium, the most powerful model (Snow Gems a message).
Support redesigned: the title sits beside Back so the whole page fits on the screen, all the Help buttons show at once, and AI Chat has a clean new look with chat bubbles.
Down channels show a warning: when anyone reports a Live TV channel down (hold OK on it > Report Channel > Channel down), it shows "Reported down right now" on every box. Hold OK and choose "It's working now" to clear it.
Plex My List: press My List on any movie or show to save it; your list is a row on Plex Home and follows your account to any box.
Plex shows: Skip Intro during a show's intro, and at the end credits an Up Next card counts down and plays the next episode, into the next season too.
Plex search: popular and recent searches as posters before you type, and a "Did you mean" row when a typo finds nothing.
Live TV: a VOD section with your line's movies and Plex pinned first; programme info and categories load only as you need them, so Live TV is lighter on memory.
Remote media buttons work in the Player: Play/Pause, and Fast-forward/Rewind skip 30 s ahead / 10 s back in films and change channel in Live TV.
Guide: a preview window plays the highlighted channel with what's on now and next.
Security: Snow Media Center only runs as the official app. A copy that has been changed won't open; install it only from snowmediaapps.com or with Downloader code 9073972.

FIXES
Opening the app shows the Snow Media splash straight away instead of a blue screen, and Live TV no longer flashes white the first time it opens.
Settings: everything fits on the screen, including the whole Phone Remote card.
Profiles: the colour picker works with the remote.
Dashboard: Right from Player account goes straight to My devices and services.
Plex: the side menu and content start below the TV's overscan band; the server line is no longer cut off.
Plex buffering card says why: your internet, the Plex server or the Plex Relay, and which quality to pick.
Older Android boxes (X96, T95): the Dashboard and Settings buttons sit at the top right again.

Plus everything in 1.7.6 and 1.7.7.
releaseNotes: Still on 1.6.6 and the update says "App not installed"? Uninstall Snow Media Center once, then reinstall it with Downloader code 9073972. Version 1.7.8 adds profiles for everyone in the house with Kids profiles and PINs, the Game Lounge, a faster Plex with 4K/1080p choice, automatic quality and a working Continue Watching, new Plex rows by streaming service, requests right inside Plex search, a phone remote (snowmediaent.com/remote), voice commands, and Game Day across every pro sport with Pay-Per-View events. Installs normally over 1.7.6 and 1.7.7.
